title: Demonizer Zilch — Before Philosophy Got Polite #Shorts
description:
Evolution does not optimize for happiness — Demonizer Zilch shows exactly where that breaks. Demonizer Zilch (Japanese: 神殺姫(かみごろしひめ)ヂルチ, Hepburn: Kamigoroshihime Djiruchi) is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Milan Matra. Sixteen-year-old Haruomi Io (射緒(イオ) 春臣, Io Haruomi) is haunted by dreams of how when he was younger his mother, sister, and childhood friend all died in a tragic accident.

Nihilism is not the conclusion of Demonizer Zilch — it is the floor you stand on while examining it. He also felt that the name dropping of Christian references and the love triangle were unoriginal. Thompson indicated that he had disliked the author's previous work, Omamori Himari, but did not go into detail on the matter.
